summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running any code or tests, and without committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch yields (patch view, coordinates) pairs with coordinates computed by removing the padding offset; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter generator; GridPatchDataset reworked to take dataset, patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates, with np.ceil worker split, exact missing-len NotImplementedError, transform applied to patch only; math import removed; PatchDataset np.float alias replaced with float), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc after GridPatchDataset), and new tests/test_grid_dataset.py (test_shape and test_loading_array). Judgment calls: the test images are np.arange(16) float 1x4x4 because that is what the pinned values imply; test_loading_array calls set_determinism at its start in addition to setUp, as the spec literally asks. Unverified: pinned random values, the GridPatchDataset docstring output (reasoned, not executed). Pre-existing lines 232-234 in utils.py exceed 120 columns in an untouched docstring and were left alone.
